scope: Fixed-seed Greed large-room movement, stops, reversals and camera boundaries; camera presentation change only.

measurement.units: native room-scroll coordinates, not physical panel pixels
measurement.reversal_rule: Opposite display step while the two latest authoritative camera segments have a consistent direction; adjacent samples less than 100 ms apart and at most two main ticks apart.
measurement.swap_timing: Native SwapBuffers return timestamps; not a physical scanout or VRR measurement.

camera_model_tests: Executed 32-bit Windows console test: 45/60/80/90/100/144 Hz, variable 48-144 Hz intervals, stop/reversal/clamp continuity, frozen-world camera samples, stationary pause, lifecycle resets and invalid-time guards.
limitations: One fixed-room fixture does not cover every camera mode, room type, moving pause or transition.
Camera display is delayed by one 60 Hz sample (about 16.7 ms); player input sampling and prediction remain unchanged.
Native sprite pixel snapping is retained; this does not claim to eliminate every sprite-level pixel step.
Physical VRR is not validated by these traces.
An initial startup timeout occurred before the camera pipeline ran; the successful retry is the measured case, and no startup root cause is claimed.
